SELECT     Brand,     COUNT(\*) FILTER (         WHERE ReturnStatus IN ('Returned', 'Exchanged', 'Return', 'Exchange')     ) AS returned_or_exchanged_orders,     COUNT(\*) FILTER (         WHERE ReturnStatus IN ('Not Returned', 'No Return', 'Not Exchanged', 'None')            OR ReturnStatus IS NULL     ) AS non_returned_orders FROM Ecommerce GROUP BY Brand ORDER BY Brand

SELECT 
    Brand,
    -- นับจำนวนคำสั่งซื้อที่มีการคืน หรือเปลี่ยนสินค้า
    COUNT(CASE 
        WHEN ReturnStatus ILIKE '%return%' OR ReturnStatus ILIKE '%exchange%' 
        THEN 1 
    END) AS ReturnOrExchangeCount,
    
    -- นับจำนวนคำสั่งซื้อที่ไม่มีการคืนสินค้า
    COUNT(CASE 
        WHEN ReturnStatus NOT ILIKE '%return%' 
         AND ReturnStatus NOT ILIKE '%exchange%' 
         OR ReturnStatus IS NULL 
        THEN 1 
    END) AS NoReturnCount,
    
    -- จำนวนคำสั่งซื้อทั้งหมดของแต่ละแบรนด์ (เผื่อไว้เปรียบเทียบภาพรวม)
    COUNT(*) AS TotalOrders
FROM 
    Ecommerce
GROUP BY 
    Brand
ORDER BY 
    Brand

SELECT OrderID, ProductName, ProductRating FROM Ecommerce WHERE (ReturnStatus IS NULL OR LOWER(ReturnStatus) IN ('no', 'none', 'not returned', 'n/a', '')) AND ProductRating >= 4.5
SELECT OrderID, ProductName FROM Ecommerce WHERE Category ILIKE '%apparel%' AND CustomerGender ILIKE 'female'

SELECT Brand,
       COUNT(DISTINCT OrderID) FILTER (WHERE ReturnStatus IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(ReturnStatus) <> '' AND LOWER(TRIM(ReturnStatus)) NOT IN ('none','no','not returned','n/a')) AS returned_or_exchanged_orders,
       COUNT(DISTINCT OrderID) FILTER (WHERE ReturnStatus IS NULL OR TRIM(ReturnStatus) = '' OR LOWER(TRIM(ReturnStatus)) IN ('none','no','not returned','n/a')) AS no_return_orders
FROM Ecommerce
GROUP BY Brand
ORDER BY Brand

SELECT
    OrderID,
    ProductName,
    ProductRating
FROM Ecommerce
WHERE ProductRating >= 4.5
  AND (
        ReturnStatus IS NULL
        OR TRIM(ReturnStatus) = ''
        OR LOWER(TRIM(ReturnStatus)) IN ('not returned', 'no', 'none', 'n/a')
